question: Who is the author of the book 'The God of Small Things'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arundhati Roy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Arundhati Roy** is the author of the novel **'The God of Small Things'**, which won the prestigious **Booker Prize** in **1997**.
 
• The book is a semi-autobiographical work set in the southern Indian state of **Kerala** and explores themes of **family, love, caste, and politics**.
 
• **'The God of Small Things'** is Roy's debut novel and received international acclaim for its **lyrical prose** and intricate narrative structure.
 
• The novel is considered a modern classic and has been translated into **more than 40 languages**, making it one of the most celebrated works of contemporary Indian literature.
 
• Arundhati Roy is also known for her activism and political commentary, focusing on issues such as **environmental justice**, human rights, and social inequality.
